source_baseline.description: Declared local Git comparison baseline; entries are extracted from working-tree sources. No online upstream identity verification is claimed.

scope.parser: Restricted TypeScript source structures; unsupported declarations fail. See tools/generate_feature_inventory.py.
scope.context_menus: Covers RequestResponseChannels:show-contextual-menu transport and shared menu/popup declarations. Dynamic IMenuItem action callbacks in app/src/ui/** are not enumerated; app/src/lib/menu-item.ts dispatches them by index.
scope.failure_recovery: Covers all PopupType, BannerType and RetryActionType members plus IPC error channels; runtime retry execution and availability are not verified.
exclusions: Popup, banner and foldout payloads and callback implementations
Runtime behavior and MyGo migration acceptance
